name: Sern Kou Resources Berhad
overview: 2026年，Sern Kou Resources Berhad 完成出售位于 Johor Tangkak 的两块工业地及地上临时建筑，交易由全资子公司 Souncern Timber Sdn. Bhd. 执行，现金代价 RM3,970,000。其余公告主要为业绩、股东大会及公司秘书变更，未披露其他业务板块的扩张、新业务或合约事项。
overview_en: In 2026, Sern Kou Resources Berhad completed the disposal of two contiguous parcels of industrial land with temporary structures in Tangkak, Johor, by its wholly-owned subsidiary Souncern Timber Sdn. Bhd. for a total cash consideration of RM3,970,000. Other announcements were mainly results, general meetings and change of company secretary, with no other expansion, new business or contract disclosed for the business segments.

segments.name: 木材加工与贸易
segments.note: 今年完成出售位于 Johor Tangkak 的两块工业地及地上临时建筑。
segments.note_en: Completed the disposal of two contiguous parcels of industrial land with temporary structures in Tangkak, Johor this year.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 上述出售已完成，收到现金代价后交易交割。
actions.text_en: The above disposal was completed following receipt of the cash consideration.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Souncern Timber Sdn. Bhd. 与 Leong Hup Agrobusiness Sdn. Bhd. 签订买卖协议，出售位于 Johor Tangkak 的两块相邻工业地及地上临时建筑，现金代价 RM3,970,000。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Souncern Timber Sdn. Bhd. entered into sale and purchase agreements with Leong Hup Agrobusiness Sdn. Bhd.
